tasks.subject: Task 2: Add the perf bench harness and baseline
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A single pasteable script that reproduces every number the later tasks are judged against, plus a recorded baseline for this machine.

**Files:**
- Create: `perf/bench.js`
- Modify: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-08-canvas-performance.md` — fill in the Baseline table in Task 2

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `dcBench.all()` returns without throwing on the sample and reports every key in the Baseline table
- [ ] `dcBench.zoomFrames()` reports `over16` and a median frame time
- [ ] `dcBench.invWrites()` reports how many times `--dc-inv-zoom` changed during one 90-tick gesture
- [ ] `dcBench.liveByZoom()` reports the live iframe count at 0.05, 0.15, 0.3, 0.5 and 0.8
- [ ] `dcBench.flowCost()` reports milliseconds per `cfMeasure` call
- [ ] `dcBench.dragFlowCost()` reports total `cfMeasure` milliseconds over a 40-frame grip drag
- [ ] `dcBench.patchCost()` reports the milliseconds a variant-chip click costs to the next frame
- [ ] The Baseline table in the plan is filled in with this machine's numbers

**Verify:** `node --check perf/bench.js` → no output, then paste the file into the sample console and run `await dcBench.all()` → an object with all seven sections populated

```json:metadata
{"files": ["perf/bench.js", "docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-08-canvas-performance.md"], "verifyCommand": "node --check perf/bench.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["node --check passes", "dcBench.all() populates all seven sections", "Baseline table filled in"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Write the zoom variable only on settle
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pinch stops invalidating style for the whole world on every frame; `--dc-inv-zoom` is written once the gesture settles.

**Files:**
- Modify: `design-canvas.jsx` — `DCViewport`: the `flushNow` callback and the `useLayoutEffect` cleanup that clears the fit and rescue timers

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `dcBench.invWrites()` reports at most 3 writes for a 90-tick gesture (was 90)
- [ ] `dcBench.zoomFrames().median` is no worse than the Task 2 baseline and `over16` is no higher
- [ ] After a pinch ends, header labels, section gaps and the section title settle to their correct screen size within DC.settleMs
- [ ] Headers are the right size on first paint, before any gesture
- [ ] The Back to content pill still appears when the view is panned off the pages, and its tween lands with the right header sizes

**Verify:** `await dcBench.invWrites()` → `{ticks: 90, invWrites: <= 3}`, then `await dcBench.zoomFrames()` → median and over16 no worse than baseline

```json:metadata
{"files": ["design-canvas.jsx"], "verifyCommand": "await dcBench.invWrites() then await dcBench.zoomFrames() in the sample console", "acceptanceCriteria": ["invWrites <= 3 for 90 ticks", "zoomFrames median and over16 no worse than baseline", "chrome settles to the right size after a pinch", "headers correct on first paint", "Back to content pill still works"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Swap snapshots for a live iframe budget
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The zoomed-out picture is gone and a slot is a live iframe at any zoom, with at most DC.liveBudget alive at once — the ones nearest the viewport centre.

**Files:**
- Modify: `design-canvas.jsx` — `DC` config, styles block, the snapshot section (`dcSnap`, `dcHash`, `dcRasterize`), `dcFontCss`, the LOD registry (`dcZoom`, `dcLodRun`, `dcLodSubscribe`), `DCLazyFrame`, the header comment block
- Modify: `README.md` — intro sentence, the `design-canvas.jsx` bullet, and the whole 'How snapshots work' section

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `document.querySelectorAll('img.dc-thumb').length` is 0 at every zoom
- [ ] `dcBench.liveByZoom()` reports live <= 8 at every zoom, including 0.05 where all 10 slots are on screen
- [ ] `dcBench.zoomFrames().over16` is 0 with the whole page on screen (unbudgeted all-live gave 14 of 88)
- [ ] `dcBench.zoomFrames().max` is under 20 ms (unbudgeted all-live gave 83.9 ms)
- [ ] The slot nearest the pointer is always live at both 0.05 and 0.8
- [ ] Download PNG and Download HTML both still produce a correct file
- [ ] `dcSnap`, `dcHash`, `dcRasterize`, `DC.liveScale` and `DC.snapWidth` no longer appear in `design-canvas.jsx`
- [ ] No `[dc-snap]` warnings in the console
- [ ] `README.md` no longer describes snapshots

**Verify:** `await dcBench.liveByZoom()` → every row live <= 8; `await dcBench.zoomFrames()` → over16 0 and max < 20; `grep -c "dcSnap\|dcRasterize\|liveScale\|snapWidth\|dc-thumb" design-canvas.jsx` → 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["design-canvas.jsx", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "grep -c 'dcSnap\\|dcRasterize\\|liveScale\\|snapWidth\\|dc-thumb' design-canvas.jsx", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no img.dc-thumb at any zoom", "liveByZoom live <= 8 everywhere", "zoomFrames over16 == 0", "zoomFrames max < 20 ms", "PNG and HTML export still work", "grep for removed symbols returns 0", "README no longer describes snapshots"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Re-render only the artboards a patch changed
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One `patchSection` re-renders the slots it changed, not all of them.

**Files:**
- Modify: `design-canvas.jsx` — the `api` memo in `DesignCanvas`, the body of `DCSection`, and `DCArtboardFrame`'s signature, body and memo wrapper

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `dcBench.patchCost().framesRenderedPerPatch` is at most 2 on the sample (was 10, one per slot)
- [ ] `dcBench.patchCost().variantSwitchMs` is at most 60 % of the Task 2 baseline
- [ ] Renaming a label, dragging a page, resetting a position, switching a variant, deleting a page and focusing a page all still work
- [ ] Reordering by dragging a grip in a non-free section still works
- [ ] The `DC.renders` counter goes up by 1 for every artboard frame render

**Verify:** `await dcBench.patchCost()` → `{framesRenderedPerPatch: <= 2, variantSwitchMs: <= 0.6 * baseline}`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["design-canvas.jsx"], "verifyCommand": "await dcBench.patchCost() in the sample console", "acceptanceCriteria": ["framesRenderedPerPatch <= 2", "variantSwitchMs <= 60% of baseline", "rename, drag, reset, variant, delete, focus all still work", "grip reorder still works", "DC.renders increments once per frame render"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Re-route only the arrows a drag moves
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Dragging a page re-routes the arrows that touch it, instead of every arrow on the page, every frame.

**Files:**
- Modify: `canvas-page.jsx` — `cfMeasure` (add the reuse path) and the `measure` callback inside `CanvasFlows`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `dcBench.dragFlowCost().cfMs` is at most 40 % of the Task 2 baseline for the same `dragFrames`
- [ ] Arrows attached to the dragged page follow it while the drag is in progress
- [ ] Arrows not attached to the dragged page do not move during the drag
- [ ] After the drop every arrow and label is in its final place, including labels that had to move to avoid a collision
- [ ] Dragging an arrow handle to another side still works and still saves

**Verify:** `await dcBench.dragFlowCost()` → cfMs at most 40 % of the Task 2 baseline, with cfCalls about the same

```json:metadata
{"files": ["canvas-page.jsx"], "verifyCommand": "await dcBench.dragFlowCost() in the sample console", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cfMs <= 40% of baseline", "arrows on the dragged page follow it", "other arrows hold still during the drag", "everything settles correctly after the drop", "arrow handle drag still saves"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```
